informal_statement:
For \(b,s\geq0\) and real \(x\),
\[
|x|\leq b+\sqrt{s}
\]
is equivalent to the disjunction
\[
-b\leq x\leq b,
\]
or
\[
(x+b)^2\leq s
\]
and
\[
x\leq-b,
\]
or
\[
(x-b)^2\leq s
\]
and
\[
x\geq b.
\]
reason: Source `CMVElementaryGeometry.lean:151-175`: The three-way section decomposition retains both nonnegativity hypotheses and both outer side cutoffs, including their endpoints.
